mapper.select: SELECT id, index_id, content, author_id, article_index_id, is_deleted, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM comments WHERE index_id = #{indexId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id, t.index_id, t.content, t.author_id, t.article_index_id, t.is_deleted, t.is_hidden, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) id, index_id, content, author_id, article_index_id, is_deleted, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM comments WHERE article_index_id = #{articleIndexId} ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE AND (t.is_hidden = FALSE OR t.author_id = #{viewerId} OR #{canViewHidden} = TRUE) ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) id, author_id, is_deleted, is_hidden FROM comments WHERE article_index_id = #{articleIndexId} ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE AND (t.is_hidden = FALSE OR t.author_id = #{viewerId} OR #{canViewHidden} = TRUE)

SELECT t.id, t.index_id, t.content, t.author_id, t.article_index_id, t.is_deleted, t.is_hidden, t.created_at, t.updated_at, a.title AS article_title FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) id, index_id, content, author_id, article_index_id, is_deleted, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM comments WHERE author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) t JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) index_id, title, is_deleted, is_hidden FROM articles ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) a ON a.index_id = t.article_index_id WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE AND (t.is_hidden = FALSE OR t.author_id = #{viewerId} OR #{canViewHidden} = TRUE) AND a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.is_hidden = FALSE ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
